newsitem.title: USA: PACE Health Management inks clinic pact.
newsitem.headline: PACE Health Management inks clinic pact.

text.p: PACE Health Management Systems Inc said Tuesday it signed an agreement to provide its Clinical Information System to Morris County Hospital in Council Grove, Kan.

The system will help the hospital automate its workflow activities and reduce clerical tasks, PACE Health Management said. The system will also allow physicians to view a patient's chart from terminals throughout the facility.
PACE Health Management Systems develops patient care management software for the health care industry.
The comany's stock was unchanged Tuesday at 3-3/8.
